findings.claim: UNH 2026 定價假設醫療成本趨勢近 10%，並退出涵蓋逾 60 萬會員的方案以保護利潤率
findings.source: Becker's Payer: UnitedHealthcare's 'deliberate trade-off' for margin recovery
findings.excerpt: For 2026 pricing, UnitedHealth assumed trend approaching 10%—and made the difficult decision to exit plans serving over 600,000 members to protect margins.

findings.claim: 2026 年第一季財報電話會議：UNH 預期 2027 年 Medicare Advantage 會員數減少約 130 萬，以會員數換利潤率；MA 成本趨勢仍高但符合定價假設
findings.source: Managed Healthcare Executive: 4 takeaways from UnitedHealth Group's first quarter earnings call (April 21, 2026)

findings.claim: CMS 2027 MA 給付預告僅 +0.09%，市場原預期 4–6%，引發管理式醫療股拋售；後續最終費率報導為平均 +2.48%
findings.source: Wedbush/MarketMinute: Rate Shock: 2027 Medicare Advantage Proposals Trigger $80 Billion Sell-Off in Managed Care；Nasdaq: UnitedHealth Jumps on CMS' MA Rate Boost

findings.claim: Humana 表示進入 2027 投標週期時，MA 給付與醫療成本趨勢的缺口比前一年更寬，並預期 2027 年 MA 方案退出影響約 60 萬會員
findings.source: Becker's Payer: Humana to exit Medicare Advantage plans covering 600,000 members in 2027
findings.excerpt: the company said the gap between MA funding and its medical cost trend was wider heading into the 2027 bid cycle than a year earlier and would require benefit and geographic adjustments

findings.claim: Evercore ISI 預期使用率 2026 年維持高檔，同業顯著改善自 2027 年起可見；UNH、Elevance、Centene、Molina 在 Q2 表示 Medicaid 利潤率 2027 將回升
findings.source: S&P Global Market Intelligence: US health insurers raise outlooks despite Q2 cost rises, shifting membership (2026-08-17)

findings.claim: BofA 預期 2027 年風險池再有較小的負向轉移、風險池穩定最可能在 2028；CMS 編碼變更若依提案定案將延後回到目標利潤率至 2028 年或更晚；Medicaid 利潤率恢復可能延至 2029–2030
findings.source: BofA Global Research: Managing headwinds in managed care (Kevin Fischbeck)

note: as_of 為依來源標題／文內日期的近似值（Humana、BofA 日期未直接見於摘要，已標註推估）；未找到 2027 共識 EPS 成長數字；Optum Health 2027 展望未找到；excerpt 為 null 者因摘要為改寫文字。
